hero.title: Nursing in Italy - The Complete Guide for International Students
hero.subtitle: Pursue accredited Nursing degrees in Italy, combining thorough clinical instruction, hospital ward rotations, and advanced patient-care methodologies. Gain recognized European qualifications enabling professional healthcare practice across Italy and the EU.

highlights.eligibility: Recognised academic qualification + English / Italian proficiency

overview: Nursing in Italy is an option for students interested in healthcare, patient care, clinical practice and professional development in Europe. Nursing education combines classroom learning, laboratory activities and supervised clinical placements in healthcare settings. The qualification is commonly known as Laurea in Infermieristica and is generally a three-year first-cycle degree.

Students who wish to Study Nursing in Italy should check the language of instruction, admission requirements, tuition fees, clinical placement arrangements and professional registration rules before selecting a university. Many nursing programs are taught in Italian, so students should verify whether an English-taught option is available for their intended intake.

With support from Edu-Hawk Worldwide, students can explore suitable universities, understand admission procedures, organize academic documents and plan applications according to official university requirements.

items: Italy can be an attractive destination for students seeking healthcare education, clinical exposure and international experience. Nursing programs generally combine theoretical subjects, skills-lab practice and supervised placements.
Top benefits of studying Nursing in Italy:
International Education: Study in a European university environment with structured healthcare education.
Clinical Exposure: Nursing students complete practical learning and clinical placements, subject to university and hospital arrangements.
Healthcare Skills: Learn patient assessment, care planning, infection prevention, communication and professional ethics.
Academic Progression: Explore further study in community health, critical care, public health or nursing research, subject to eligibility.
International Experience: Experience a different academic and healthcare environment and interact with diverse communities.
Students considering Nursing in Italy should also plan for Italian-language learning, as communication with patients and clinical teams is essential during placements.

The standard university pathway is the three-year Bachelor's degree in Nursing, known as Laurea in Infermieristica. It commonly carries 180 ECTS credits and includes academic study, skills practice and clinical training.
Topics commonly covered:
Human Anatomy and Physiology
Fundamentals of Nursing
Medical and Surgical Nursing
Pharmacology and Medication Safety
Microbiology and Infection Prevention
Clinical Assessment and Patient Care
Emergency and Critical Care Fundamentals
Community and Public Health Nursing
Mental Health Nursing
Ethics, Communication and Healthcare Law
The curriculum and placement hours vary by university. Students should review the official course plan for the intended intake.
3. Best Nursing Universities in Italy

Several Italian universities offer Nursing degree programs. International applicants should confirm the current course language, admission procedure, available seats, clinical placement requirements and deadlines directly with each university.
University of Bologna - Bologna
Offers healthcare-related degree programs, including Nursing. Check the current course listing, teaching language and admission notice.
Sapienza University of Rome - Rome
A major public university with health-sciences programs. Verify Nursing degree details, course language and international admission route.
University of Milan - Milan
Offers healthcare education across its academic network. Check the current Nursing course location, language and admission requirements.
University of Padua - Padua
Provides health-related university education. Consult the official course page for Nursing availability and admission information.
4. Requirements for Studying Nursing in Italy
Indian students applying for Nursing in Italy must meet the academic, language and admission requirements of their selected university.
Academic Qualifications
Class 12 or an equivalent recognized qualification.
Science subjects may be preferred or required depending on the university and admission rules.
Meet minimum academic requirements stated in the official admission notice.
Provide valid school certificates and academic records.

Applicants should verify whether NEET or any other India-specific requirement applies to their intended course and current regulations. Do not assume one rule applies to every Italian university or nursing pathway.
Language Requirements
Italian-taught programs generally require adequate Italian proficiency; universities may specify a level or accepted certificate.
English-taught programs may require proof of English proficiency, such as IELTS, TOEFL or another accepted qualification.
Clinical placements require effective communication with patients and healthcare staff; Italian language skills are especially important.
Entrance Exam

Admission may involve a university-specific or national selection procedure, depending on the course, applicant category and academic year. Check the official notice for exam format, deadlines and eligibility.

sections.title: Cost of Nursing Studies in Italy

items: The cost of Nursing studies in Italy depends on the university, city, accommodation, student eligibility and lifestyle. The figures below are broad planning estimates, not official fee quotations.
Indicative conversion used: €1 = ₹100. Exchange rates change, so actual INR costs may differ.
Estimated annual tuition fees
Public universities: ₹50,000 - ₹4,00,000
Private universities: ₹3,00,000 - ₹12,00,000+
Public university fees may depend on income assessment, fee bands, regional rules and available reductions. Check the university's published fee schedule.
Estimated monthly living expenses
Accommodation: ₹25,000 - ₹60,000
Food and groceries: ₹15,000 - ₹25,000
Personal expenses: ₹7,000 - ₹15,000
Estimated monthly total: ₹50,000 - ₹1,08,000
Living expenses vary by city, housing type and lifestyle. Costs in larger cities may be higher.
Estimated total for a three-year degree
Public university tuition - 3 years: ₹1.5 lakh - ₹12 lakh
Living expenses - 3 years: ₹18 lakh - ₹38.88 lakh
Overall indicative estimate: ₹19.5 lakh - ₹50.88 lakh

These estimates exclude airfare, visa charges, insurance, residence permit costs, translations, document legalization and other one-time expenses. Confirm actual costs with the university and relevant authorities.

sections.title: Nursing Licensing and Registration in Italy

items: Graduates who want to work as nurses in Italy must meet applicable qualification recognition, professional registration and language requirements. Completing a degree alone does not automatically authorize professional practice.
Professional requirements may include:
Completion of a recognized Nursing qualification.
Meeting applicable professional qualification and registration rules.
Registration with the competent Italian professional body, where required.
Adequate Italian language and patient communication skills.
Compliance with healthcare regulations, professional ethics and workplace requirements.
Can Indian Students Work as Nurses in India after Studying in Italy?

Indian students returning after a foreign Nursing qualification must meet current Indian recognition, examination, registration and licensing requirements applicable to their qualification. Verify rules with relevant Indian nursing authorities before enrolling abroad.
Check recognition of the university and Nursing program.
Confirm course duration, curriculum and clinical training.
Verify required screening, examination or registration steps.
Confirm eligibility to register and practice in India.
A foreign Nursing degree does not by itself guarantee permission to practice in India or another country.

Nursing can lead to career opportunities in hospitals, clinics, community healthcare, long-term care facilities, research and educational institutions. Employment depends on qualification recognition, professional registration, language skills and local hiring requirements.
Possible career roles
Registered Nurse
Hospital or Clinical Nurse
Community Health Nurse
Emergency or Critical Care Nurse, with relevant training
Mental Health Nurse, with relevant training
Pediatric Nurse, with relevant training
Nursing Research Assistant
Nursing Educator, subject to further qualifications
Nursing Salary in Italy

Nursing salaries vary by region, employer, experience, shift pattern, contract and specialization. Applicants should review current job postings and salary agreements in Italy and calculate the equivalent using the current exchange rate.
Career opportunities in India
Private and government hospitals, subject to eligibility
Clinics and healthcare centers
Community and public health organizations
Nursing education and research, with required qualifications
Check licensing requirements in the country where you intend to work before choosing a university.

faq.question: How many years does it take to complete Nursing in Italy?
faq.answer: The standard Nursing degree is generally three years and includes academic learning, skills practice and clinical placements. Confirm the duration of the specific program.

faq.question: Can Indian students study Nursing in Italy in English?
faq.answer: Some courses or related healthcare programs may offer English instruction, but many Nursing degrees are taught in Italian. Verify current course language and clinical placement requirements.

faq.question: How much does it cost to study Nursing in Italy in INR?
faq.answer: A broad three-year planning estimate including tuition and living costs may range from around ₹19.5 lakh to ₹50.88 lakh. Actual expenses depend on university, city, fees and lifestyle.

faq.question: Is NEET compulsory for Indian students to study Nursing in Italy?
faq.answer: Do not assume NEET is universally required for Nursing admission in Italy. Check current university admission rules and applicable Indian regulations for your intended course.

faq.question: Can I work in India after completing Nursing in Italy?
faq.answer: You may pursue registration and employment after meeting applicable Indian qualification recognition, examination and nursing registration requirements. Verify current rules with relevant authorities before enrolling abroad.
